title: Copy and validate responsive srcset figures during article publication

source.summary: A file-identity comparison before initial publication found missing responsive figure copies in the generated candidate.

steps: Build the registered ATRL publication candidate.
Compare all 76 reviewed dist files and each picture/source srcset against the candidate.
observed.expected: All referenced desktop and mobile SVG variants are copied and their references validated.
observed.actual: The publisher copied src/href/poster assets but omitted 18 mobile SVGs referenced only through srcset (9 per language). The candidate was withheld from deployment.

evidence: The reviewed dist has 36 explanatory SVG variants; the affected candidate omitted all 18 mobile variants.
Independent publication preflight confirmed the missing-file list.
limitations: The defect was found in a local candidate before this new article was deployed. This record does not claim a site-wide audit of older article mobile views.

policy_decision.rationale: Responsive figures are part of the authorized final publication and must reach the reader with their reviewed identities.

authority.basis: The editor explicitly requested publication of the reviewed article.
authority.current_scope: Repair and verify the necessary article asset-delivery path while preserving existing published content.

acceptance_criteria: Copy supported srcset candidates through existing asset and path restrictions.
Reject unsafe or missing local candidates and keep unapproved working files excluded.
Confirm all 76 article files are present, 74 non-HTML assets match reviewed source bytes, and actual mobile Figure 9 renders.
Pass the release continuity guard and verify actual HTTPS files after deployment.

checks: Initial candidate withheld due to missing responsive assets.
The srcset copier and local-reference validator now process supported URL/descriptor candidates using existing asset/path checks.
Six srcset regression tests and the complete Python suite (329 tests, one skip) passed.
remaining_limits: Corrected candidate, browser and actual deployment verification pending.

next_action: Finish srcset regression checks, rebuild one corrected candidate, verify browser and release continuity, then publish and record live file identities.
